Input image 1 is the ACTUAL game's crystal heart sword: use only its pearl-white, very pale cyan and quiet opal colors. Input image 2 is the ACTUAL existing crystal-slash cel: use its clean anime illustrated palette only; do NOT copy its crescent or impact shape.
Create exactly ONE slender, smooth, continuous rightward passage streak. It represents a heart sword passing through a person's black color without cutting anything. The streak is a single gently rising diagonal needle/ribbon from lower-left to upper-right, about 10 degrees above horizontal, pointed at both ends, modestly thicker through the middle, no stop or concentrated flare at the midpoint. Broad smooth pearl-white opaque inner core with a very restrained pale cyan/opal rim; avoid numerous bands or facets. No dark outline. It must read clearly when later reduced to about 160 pixels long. At a 1536 x 1024 canvas, the streak is about 940 pixels long and its widest core about 65 pixels thick. Center the whole streak around (768,512) with generous genuine transparent margins. It is a single connected contour: no secondary swoosh, detached spark, dot, shard, star, spatter, dust, wave ripples or particles. No crescents, explosive rays, impact ring, wound, cut body, peeled shell, black residue or debris. No actual sword/weapon, character, face, eye, creature, target, scenery, floor, shadow, text, numbers, grid, border, watermark, white backing plate, black backdrop or painted checkerboard. True transparent alpha everywhere outside this one trace; only minimal smooth antialiasing at the outer contour, no long fuzzy glow cloud. Stable clean illustrated anime game VFX matching the references.
